❤️ J-RED Loop 114 — SHORT: bind the official Codex ACP executable name to the existing static provider profile.

Goal:
The accepted Codex profile already carries CODEX_POLICY.external_agent and CODEX_POLICY.pinned_version, but currently has no binary_name. Adapt ONLY the documented official codex-acp binary name into its existing ProviderStaticProfile field, ready for a LATER separately authorized/mock adapter wiring step. This mission must NEVER launch Codex, npx, npm, any provider, or a model.

Read first:
- src/providers/codex_acp.py::build_codex_profile
- src/providers/base.py::ProviderStaticProfile (read-only)
- src/providers/policy.py::CODEX_POLICY (read-only; currently pinned version 2.1.0)
- tests/relay/test_provider_adapters.py::test_codex_profile_pass_and_adapter_compatible_config and existing invariant/no-duplication tests
- Official agentclientprotocol/codex-acp tag v2.1.0 (https://github.com/agentclientprotocol/codex-acp/tree/v2.1.0), package.json bin entry "codex-acp": "dist/index.js", official README installation section. Reference only; do not vendor or install.

Allowed changed paths ONLY:
- src/providers/codex_acp.py
- tests/relay/test_provider_adapters.py

Hard scope / Do Not Touch:
- No process launch, no network requests in production/tests, no npx -y or implicit package installation, no provider/model/API/auth call.
- No new dependency, helper module, generic launcher, provider selector, lifecycle/Relay core changes, new docs or framework.
- Do not modify src/providers/base.py, policy.py, preflight.py, other provider profiles, ACP client or transport, command bus, Gate, or workflow.
- Do not duplicate the pinned-version or full @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp package literal in codex_acp.py; use CODEX_POLICY as existing source of truth.
- retry=0, fallback=disabled, no Merge/default-branch write/rebase/force push/branch deletion, no billing/permission/settings changes.

Existing implementation to reuse:
- ProviderStaticProfile already has optional binary_name field and enforces static safety invariants.
- build_antigravity_profile + its test already demonstrate setting profile.binary_name. Follow that limited precedent without copying Antigravity-specific logic.

Required semantics:
1. On build_codex_profile successful validation, set ProviderStaticProfile.binary_name to the official executable name "codex-acp"; preserve existing provider_id, external_agent, pinned_version, deep-copied preflight configuration, retry/fallback and live_ready=False.
2. Do not claim that any binary is installed or any authentication, account/billing route, or live readiness is verified.
3. Extend the existing Codex adapter test to assert exact binary_name and preserve current PASS/blocked static preflight semantics. Reuse CODEX_POLICY for pinned_version check; no duplicate package/version strings in codex_acp.py.

Negative / failure cases:
- Existing invalid auth and malformed route_evidence tests must still reject; do not relax any validation.
- A static profile check must never execute a child process or contact a provider.

Acceptance criteria:
- Exact 2-file allowlist, minimal compatible diff, no speculative launch framework.
- Existing provider-adapter tests and full suite PASS; no live/provider/model/API/remote execution.
- No version upgrade; retain existing official v2.1.0 pin and current tests.

Exact validation:
PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.relay.test_provider_adapters -v
PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
python -m compileall -q src tests
git diff --check

Publication:
Publish only the normal isolated Jules PR if all tests pass; no Merge or canonical changes.

Explicit stop:
If setting the official binary_name cannot be done solely in these two files, or if the existing profile contract conflicts, stop and report exact incompatibility. Do not redesign or widen scope.
